changelog: Fixes channel viewing still showing up as watched even though nothing was written to the database: the server hands out one cached watch-state object per item, and everything that records playback changes that object before asking for it to be saved - so blocking the save alone left the item marked played in memory until the next server restart. While a program airs on a channel the plugin now hands out a copy, so those changes land nowhere at all.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
